Used ffmpeg pixel sampling to extract exact colors from the reference video at grid center positions.
Iterated through 30+ render-and-compare cycles, adjusting radius, corner rounding, bow depth, morph timing ramps, and color values.
Used PSNR as the primary optimization metric, achieving final average PSNR of ~20.56 dB.
Bottom row was set to constant circles (m=0) which may not match the reference morphing pattern exactly.
